page_title: HOF 1-1 RBL | Hoffenheim v RB Leipzig 03/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi is equal to it and makes an easy save.

90+4' Bambase Conte (Hoffenheim) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.

90+3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bambase Conte (Hoffenheim) is coming onto the pitch as Ihlas Bebou cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Marius Bulter and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
87' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
86' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is David Raum (RB Leipzig).
86' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) tries to find Andrej Kramaric, but he puts too much power on the pass.
85' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
85' The free kick is delivered by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
84' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and signals a foul after David Raum (RB Leipzig) brought his opponent down. Hoffenheim have been awarded a free kick.

84' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
82' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
79' Here comes a substitution. Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Ozan Kabak.
79' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. Anton Stach is replaced by Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim).
78' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 13:8.
77' Substitution. Amadou Haidara walks off the pitch and Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
77' Substitution. Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) in, Lois Openda out.
77' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) replacing Dani Olmo.
76' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
75' RB Leipzig win a free kick.
74' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

74' Hoffenheim slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
73' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
72' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is being dismissed by the referee, after receiving two yellow cards, followed by a red.
69' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) replaces Maximilian Beier.
67' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
67' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
64' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Peter Gulacsi easily deals with the threat.
62' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
59' Benjamin Sesko will be replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
58' The resulting corner, taken by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig), comes to nothing.
58' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner with a short pass.

57' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
55' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
55' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) gets booked.
53' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
49' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
47' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and Harm Osmers immediately signals a free kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).

45+1' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.

45+1' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Corner kick. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
42' The linesman raises his flag. Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is adjudged offside.
41' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Peter Gulacsi produces a wonderful reflex save.
38' 0 - 1 Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
37' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
35' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
34' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

32' Amadou Haidara sends a good ball to the edge of the box and Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) gets in a shot which goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
32' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
32' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
30' It looks like Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) saw red with that tackle. Harm Osmers won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
28' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
27' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
27' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Hoffenheim will have a corner.
25' The players claim that Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
23' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Peter Gulacsi intercepts the ball.
23' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
23' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

22' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim). The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Peter Gulacsi has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
19' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
17' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
17' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick, but Oliver Baumann reads it well and stops the effort.

17' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Oliver Baumann, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
16' Problems for Marco Rose as Xaver Schlager is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) replaces him.
14' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) picks up an injury.
13' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
13' David Raum (RB Leipzig) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
11' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
9' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
7' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.

5' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
3' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.

2' Ambitious effort from Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
